## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Patch Safety

- [ ] No Garmin/Suzuki firmware or patched firmware included.
- [ ] No extracted firmware payloads included.
- [ ] Existing default patch behavior is unchanged, or the change is clearly documented.
- [ ] New patch has expected bytes, replacement bytes, offset, and verification behavior documented.

## Testing

- [ ] Source dry-run tested.
- [ ] GUI launch tested, if affected.
- [ ] Real-device testing documented, if firmware behavior changed.

## Notes

Add risks, limitations, or follow-up work.
